1CH.28.10.t: Take heed now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”
s: Take heed now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

1CH.28.11.t: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;
s: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

1CH.28.12.t: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
s: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

1CH.28.13.t: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all the vessels of service in Yahweh’s house—
s: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all the vessels of service in Yahweh’s house—

1CH.28.14.t: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;
s: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;

1CH.28.15.t: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;
s: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

1CH.28.16.t: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;
s: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

1CH.28.17.t: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
s: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

1CH.28.18.t: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of Yahweh’s covenant.
s: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of Yahweh’s covenant.

1CH.28.19.t: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”
s: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

1CH.28.20.t: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for Yahweh God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of Yahweh’s house is finished.
s: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for Yahweh God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of Yahweh’s house is finished.

1CH.28.21.t: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”
s: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

1CO.4.1.t: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.
s: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

1CO.4.2.t: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
s: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

1CO.4.3.t: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.
s: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

1CO.4.4.t: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
s: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

1CO.4.5.t: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
s: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

1CO.7.17.t: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
s: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

1CO.7.18.t: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.
s: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

1CO.7.19.t: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.
s: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

1CO.7.20.t: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.
s: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

1CO.7.21.t: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
s: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

1CO.7.22.t: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.
s: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

1CO.7.23.t: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.
s: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

1CO.7.24.t: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.
s: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

1CO.9.19.t: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
s: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

1CO.9.20.t: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;
s: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

1CO.9.21.t: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.
s: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

1CO.9.22.t: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.
s: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

1CO.9.23.t: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.
s: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

1CO.9.24.t: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.
s: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

1CO.9.25.t: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.
s: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

1CO.9.26.t: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,
s: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

1CO.9.27.t: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.
s: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

1CO.10.6.t: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.
s: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

1CO.10.7.t: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”
s: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

1CO.10.8.t: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.
s: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

1CO.10.9.t: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
s: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

1CO.10.10.t: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
s: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

1CO.10.11.t: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
s: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

1CO.10.12.t: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
s: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

1CO.10.13.t: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
s: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

1CO.10.14.t: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
s: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

1CO.12.14.t: For the body is not one member, but many.
s: For the body is not one member, but many.

1CO.12.15.t: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
s: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

1CO.12.16.t: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
s: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

1CO.12.17.t: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
s: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

1CO.12.18.t: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
s: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

1CO.12.19.t: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
s: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

1CO.12.20.t: But now they are many members, but one body.
s: But now they are many members, but one body.

1CO.12.21.t: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
s: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

1CO.12.22.t: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
s: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

1CO.12.23.t: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,
s: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

1CO.12.24.t: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
s: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

1CO.12.25.t: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
s: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

1CO.12.26.t: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
s: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

1CO.12.31.t: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
s: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

1CO.13.1.t: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
s: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

1CO.13.2.t: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
s: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

1CO.13.3.t: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
s: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

1CO.13.4.t: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
s: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

1CO.13.5.t: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
s: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

1CO.13.6.t: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
s: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

1CO.13.7.t: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
s: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

1CO.13.8.t: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
s: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

1CO.13.9.t: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;
s: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

1CO.13.10.t: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
s: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

1CO.13.11.t: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
s: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

1CO.13.12.t: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
s: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

1CO.13.13.t: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
s: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

1CO.15.55.t: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
s: “Death, where is your sting?
Hades, where is your victory?”

1CO.15.56.t: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
s: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

1CO.15.57.t: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
s: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

1CO.15.58.t: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
s: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

1CO.16.5.t: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
s: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

1CO.16.6.t: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
s: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

1CO.16.7.t: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
s: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

1CO.16.8.t: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
s: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

1CO.16.9.t: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
s: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

1CO.16.10.t: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
s: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

1CO.16.11.t: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
s: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

1CO.16.12.t: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
s: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

1CO.16.13.t: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
s: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

1CO.16.14.t: Let all that you do be done in love.
s: Let all that you do be done in love.

1JN.1.5.t: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
s: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

1JN.1.6.t: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
s: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

1JN.1.7.t: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
s: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

1JN.1.8.t: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
s: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

1JN.1.9.t: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
s: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

1JN.1.10.t: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
s: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

1JN.2.1.t: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
s: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

1JN.2.2.t: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
s: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

1JN.2.28.t: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
s: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

1JN.2.29.t: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
s: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

1JN.3.1.t: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
s: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

1JN.3.2.t: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
s: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

1JN.3.3.t: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
s: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

1JN.3.11.t: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
s: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

1JN.3.12.t: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
s: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

1JN.3.13.t: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
s: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

1JN.3.14.t: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
s: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

1JN.3.15.t: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
s: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

1JN.3.16.t: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
s: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

1JN.3.17.t: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
s: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

1JN.3.18.t: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
s: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

1JN.4.7.t: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
s: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

1JN.4.8.t: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
s: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

1JN.4.9.t: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
s: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

1JN.4.10.t: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
s: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

1JN.4.11.t: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
s: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

1JN.4.12.t: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
s: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

1KI.3.5.t: In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”
s: In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”

1KI.3.6.t: Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you. You have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.
s: Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you. You have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.

1KI.3.7.t: Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.
s: Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.

1KI.3.8.t: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.
s: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.

1KI.3.9.t: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”
s: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”

1KI.3.10.t: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
s: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

1KI.3.11.t: God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,
s: God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,

1KI.3.12.t: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.
s: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.

1KI.4.29.t: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom, understanding, and breadth of mind like the sand that is on the seashore.
s: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom, understanding, and breadth of mind like the sand that is on the seashore.

1KI.4.30.t: Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.
s: Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.

1KI.4.31.t: For he was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the nations all around.
s: For he was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the nations all around.

1KI.4.32.t: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one thousand five.
s: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one thousand five.

1KI.4.33.t: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall; he also spoke of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.
s: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall; he also spoke of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.

1KI.4.34.t: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, sent by all kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.
s: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, sent by all kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.

1KI.12.3.t: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
s: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

1KI.12.4.t: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”
s: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

1KI.12.5.t: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.
s: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.”
So the people departed.

1KI.12.6.t: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”
s: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”

1KI.12.7.t: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”
s: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”

1KI.12.8.t: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
s: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

1KI.12.9.t: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”
s: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

1KI.12.10.t: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
s: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

1KI.12.11.t: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”
s: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

1KI.12.12.t: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
s: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

1KI.12.13.t: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,
s: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,

1KI.12.14.t: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”
s: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

1KI.19.3.t: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.
s: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

1KI.19.4.t: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O Yahweh, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”
s: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O Yahweh, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”

1KI.19.5.t: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”
s: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”

1KI.19.6.t: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.
s: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

1KI.19.7.t: Yahweh’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”
s: Yahweh’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”

1KI.19.8.t: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.
s: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.

1KI.19.9.t: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
s: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

1KI.19.10.t: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”
s: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

1KI.19.11.t: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before Yahweh.” Behold, Yahweh passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before Yahweh; but Yahweh was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but Yahweh was not in the earthquake.
s: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before Yahweh.”

Behold, Yahweh passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before Yahweh; but Yahweh was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but Yahweh was not in the earthquake.

1KI.19.12.t: After the earthquake a fire passed; but Yahweh was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.
s: After the earthquake a fire passed; but Yahweh was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.

1KI.19.13.t: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
s: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

1KI.19.14.t: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”
s: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

1KI.19.15.t: Yahweh said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.
s: Yahweh said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

1KI.19.16.t: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.
s: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.

1KI.19.17.t: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.
s: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

1KI.19.18.t: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him.”
s: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

1PE.1.3.t: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
s: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

1PE.1.4.t: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
s: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

1PE.1.5.t: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
s: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

1PE.1.6.t: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
s: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

1PE.1.7.t: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
s: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

1PE.1.8.t: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
s: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

1PE.1.9.t: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
s: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

1PE.2.4.t: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
s: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

1PE.2.5.t: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
s: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

1PE.2.6.t: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
s: Because it is contained in Scripture,
“Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious.
He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

1PE.2.7.t: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
s: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient,
“The stone which the builders rejected
has become the chief cornerstone,”

1PE.2.8.t: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
s: and,
“a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.”
For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

1PE.2.9.t: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
s: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

1PE.2.10.t: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
s: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

1PE.3.8.t: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
s: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

1PE.3.9.t: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
s: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

1PE.3.10.t: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
s: For,
“He who would love life
and see good days,
let him keep his tongue from evil
and his lips from speaking deceit.

1PE.3.11.t: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
s: Let him turn away from evil and do good.
Let him seek peace and pursue it.

1PE.3.12.t: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
s: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous,
and his ears open to their prayer;
but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

1PE.4.7.t: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
s: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

1PE.4.8.t: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
s: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

1PE.4.9.t: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
s: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

1PE.4.10.t: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
s: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

1PE.4.11.t: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
s: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

1PE.5.1.t: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
s: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

1PE.5.2.t: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
s: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

1PE.5.3.t: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
s: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

1PE.5.4.t: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
s: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

1PE.5.5.t: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
s: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

1PE.5.6.t: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
s: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

1PE.5.7.t: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
s: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

1PE.5.8.t: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
s: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

1PE.5.9.t: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
s: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

1PE.5.10.t: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
s: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

1PE.5.11.t: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
s: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

1SA.1.9.t: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of Yahweh’s temple.
s: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of Yahweh’s temple.

1SA.1.10.t: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to Yahweh, weeping bitterly.
s: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to Yahweh, weeping bitterly.

1SA.1.11.t: She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to Yahweh all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”
s: She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to Yahweh all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”

1SA.1.12.t: As she continued praying before Yahweh, Eli saw her mouth.
s: As she continued praying before Yahweh, Eli saw her mouth.

1SA.1.13.t: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.
s: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.

1SA.1.14.t: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”
s: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”

1SA.1.15.t: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.
s: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.

1SA.1.16.t: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”
s: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”

1SA.1.17.t: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”
s: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”

1SA.1.18.t: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.
s: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.

1SA.3.1.t: The child Samuel ministered to Yahweh before Eli. Yahweh’s word was rare in those days. There were not many visions, then.
s: The child Samuel ministered to Yahweh before Eli. Yahweh’s word was rare in those days. There were not many visions, then.

1SA.3.2.t: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),
s: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),

1SA.3.3.t: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in Yahweh’s temple where God’s ark was,
s: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in Yahweh’s temple where God’s ark was,

1SA.3.4.t: Yahweh called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”
s: Yahweh called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”

1SA.3.5.t: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He said, “I didn’t call. Lie down again.” He went and lay down.
s: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.”
He said, “I didn’t call. Lie down again.”
He went and lay down.

1SA.3.6.t: Yahweh called yet again, “Samuel!” Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He answered, “I didn’t call, my son. Lie down again.”
s: Yahweh called yet again, “Samuel!”
Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.”
He answered, “I didn’t call, my son. Lie down again.”

1SA.3.7.t: Now Samuel didn’t yet know Yahweh, neither was Yahweh’s word yet revealed to him.
s: Now Samuel didn’t yet know Yahweh, neither was Yahweh’s word yet revealed to him.

1SA.3.8.t: Yahweh called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” Eli perceived that Yahweh had called the child.
s: Yahweh called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.”
Eli perceived that Yahweh had called the child.

1SA.3.9.t: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, Yahweh; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
s: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, Yahweh; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

1SA.3.10.t: Yahweh came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”
s: Yahweh came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!”
Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”

1SA.16.1.t: Yahweh said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”
s: Yahweh said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”

1SA.16.2.t: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.” Yahweh said, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh.’
s: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.”
Yahweh said, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh.’

1SA.16.3.t: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”
s: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”

1SA.16.4.t: Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”
s: Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”

1SA.16.5.t: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.
s: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

1SA.16.6.t: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely Yahweh’s anointed is before him.”
s: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely Yahweh’s anointed is before him.”

1SA.16.7.t: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”
s: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”

1SA.16.8.t: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”
s: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

1SA.16.9.t: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”
s: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

1SA.16.10.t: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “Yahweh has not chosen these.”
s: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “Yahweh has not chosen these.”

1SA.16.11.t: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?” He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.” Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”
s: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?”
He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.”
Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”

1SA.16.12.t: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”
s: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”

1SA.16.13.t: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.
s: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.

1SA.17.32.t: David said to Saul, “Let no man’s heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.”
s: David said to Saul, “Let no man’s heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.”

1SA.17.33.t: Saul said to David, “You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for you are but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.”
s: Saul said to David, “You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for you are but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.”

1SA.17.34.t: David said to Saul, “Your servant was keeping his father’s sheep; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,
s: David said to Saul, “Your servant was keeping his father’s sheep; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,

1SA.17.35.t: I went out after him, struck him, and rescued it out of his mouth. When he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, struck him, and killed him.
s: I went out after him, struck him, and rescued it out of his mouth. When he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, struck him, and killed him.

1SA.17.36.t: Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God.”
s: Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God.”

1SA.17.37.t: David said, “Yahweh, who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.” Saul said to David, “Go! Yahweh will be with you.”
s: David said, “Yahweh, who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.”
Saul said to David, “Go! Yahweh will be with you.”

1SA.19.1.t: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.
s: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.

1SA.19.2.t: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.
s: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.

1SA.19.3.t: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”
s: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”

1SA.19.4.t: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;
s: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;

1SA.19.5.t: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”
s: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”

1SA.19.6.t: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, “As Yahweh lives, he shall not be put to death.”
s: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, “As Yahweh lives, he shall not be put to death.”

1SA.19.7.t: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.
s: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.

1SA.23.14.t: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn’t deliver him into his hand.
s: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn’t deliver him into his hand.

1SA.23.15.t: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the woods.
s: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the woods.

1SA.23.16.t: Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.
s: Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.

1SA.23.17.t: He said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father won’t find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father knows that also.”
s: He said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father won’t find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father knows that also.”

1SA.23.18.t: They both made a covenant before Yahweh. Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house.
s: They both made a covenant before Yahweh. Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house.

1SA.24.1.t: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”
s: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”

1SA.24.2.t: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.
s: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.

1SA.24.3.t: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.
s: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.

1SA.24.4.t: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which Yahweh said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.
s: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which Yahweh said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.

1SA.24.5.t: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
s: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

1SA.24.6.t: He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is Yahweh’s anointed.”
s: He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is Yahweh’s anointed.”

1SA.24.7.t: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
s: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

1SA.24.8.t: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.
s: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!”
When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.

1SA.24.9.t: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you’?
s: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you’?

1SA.24.10.t: Behold, today your eyes have seen how Yahweh had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is Yahweh’s anointed.’
s: Behold, today your eyes have seen how Yahweh had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is Yahweh’s anointed.’

1TH.5.11.t: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
s: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

1TH.5.12.t: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
s: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

1TH.5.13.t: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
s: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake.
Be at peace among yourselves.

1TH.5.14.t: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
s: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

1TH.5.15.t: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
s: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
Always rejoice.
Pray without ceasing.

1TH.5.18.t: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
s: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
Don’t quench the Spirit.
Don’t despise prophecies.

1TH.5.21.t: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
s: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

1TH.5.22.t: Abstain from every form of evil.
s: Abstain from every form of evil.

1TH.5.23.t: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
s: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1TH.5.24.t: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
s: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
Command and teach these things.

1TI.4.12.t: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
s: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

1TI.4.13.t: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
s: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

1TI.4.14.t: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
s: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

1TI.4.15.t: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
s: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

1TI.4.16.t: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
s: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

2CH.20.5.t: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in Yahweh’s house, before the new court;
s: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in Yahweh’s house, before the new court;

2CH.20.6.t: and he said, “Yahweh, the God of our fathers, aren’t you God in heaven? Aren’t you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in your hand, so that no one is able to withstand you.
s: and he said, “Yahweh, the God of our fathers, aren’t you God in heaven? Aren’t you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in your hand, so that no one is able to withstand you.

2CH.20.7.t: Didn’t you, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it to the offspring of Abraham your friend forever?
s: Didn’t you, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it to the offspring of Abraham your friend forever?

2CH.20.8.t: They lived in it, and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name, saying,
s: They lived in it, and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name, saying,

2CH.20.9.t: ‘If evil comes on us—the sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine—we will stand before this house, and before you (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.’
s: ‘If evil comes on us—the sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine—we will stand before this house, and before you (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.’

2CH.20.10.t: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;
s: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;

2CH.20.11.t: behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.
s: behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.

2CH.20.12.t: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know what to do, but our eyes are on you.”
s: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know what to do, but our eyes are on you.”

2CO.1.3.t: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
s: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

2CO.1.4.t: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
s: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

2CO.1.5.t: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
s: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

2CO.1.6.t: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.
s: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

2CO.1.7.t: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
s: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

2CO.1.8.t: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
s: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

2CO.1.9.t: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
s: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

2CO.1.10.t: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,
s: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

2CO.1.11.t: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
s: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

2CO.3.1.t: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
s: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

2CO.3.2.t: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
s: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

2CO.3.3.t: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.
s: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

2CO.3.4.t: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,
s: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

2CO.3.5.t: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,
s: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

2CO.3.6.t: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
s: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

2CO.4.6.t: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
s: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

2CO.4.7.t: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.
s: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

2CO.4.8.t: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
s: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

2CO.4.9.t: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;
s: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

2CO.4.10.t: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
