s: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

2CO.12.7.t: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
s: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

2CO.12.8.t: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
s: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

2CO.12.9.t: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
s: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

2CO.12.10.t: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
s: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

2PE.1.3.t: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,
s: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

2PE.1.4.t: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
s: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

2PE.1.5.t: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;
s: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

2PE.1.6.t: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;
s: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

2PE.1.7.t: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
s: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

2PE.1.8.t: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
s: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

2SA.9.1.t: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”
s: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”

2SA.9.2.t: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”
s: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?”
He said, “I am your servant.”

2SA.9.3.t: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”
s: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?”
Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”

2SA.9.4.t: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”
s: The king said to him, “Where is he?”
Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”

2SA.9.5.t: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.
s: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.

2SA.9.6.t: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”
s: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?”
He answered, “Behold, your servant!”

2SA.9.7.t: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”
s: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”

2SA.9.8.t: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”
s: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”

2SA.9.9.t: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.
s: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.

2SA.9.10.t: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
s: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.”
Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

2SA.9.11.t: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.
s: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.

2SA.9.12.t: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.
s: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.

2SA.9.13.t: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.
s: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.

2TH.3.16.t: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
s: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

2TH.3.17.t: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.
s: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

2TH.3.18.t: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
s: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

2TI.1.3.t: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
s: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

2TI.1.4.t: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
s: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

2TI.1.5.t: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
s: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

2TI.1.6.t: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
s: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

2TI.1.7.t: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
s: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

2TI.1.8.t: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
s: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

2TI.2.1.t: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
s: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

2TI.2.2.t: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
s: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

2TI.2.3.t: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
s: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

2TI.2.4.t: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
s: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

2TI.2.5.t: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.
s: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

2TI.2.6.t: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.
s: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

2TI.2.7.t: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
s: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

2TI.2.14.t: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
s: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

2TI.2.15.t: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
s: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

2TI.2.16.t: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
s: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

2TI.2.17.t: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
s: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

2TI.2.18.t: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
s: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

2TI.2.19.t: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
s: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

2TI.3.10.t: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
s: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

2TI.3.11.t: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
s: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

2TI.3.12.t: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
s: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

2TI.3.13.t: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
s: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

2TI.3.14.t: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
s: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

2TI.3.15.t: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
s: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

2TI.3.16.t: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,
s: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

2TI.3.17.t: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
s: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

2TI.4.9.t: Be diligent to come to me soon,
s: Be diligent to come to me soon,

2TI.4.10.t: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.
s: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

2TI.4.11.t: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
s: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

2TI.4.12.t: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
s: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

2TI.4.13.t: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.
s: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

2TI.4.14.t: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
s: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

2TI.4.15.t: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.
s: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

2TI.4.16.t: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
s: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

2TI.4.17.t: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
s: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

2TI.4.18.t: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
s: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

ACT.13.32.t: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,
s: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

ACT.13.33.t: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’
s: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm,
‘You are my Son.
Today I have become your father.’

ACT.13.34.t: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
s: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

ACT.13.35.t: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’
s: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

ACT.13.36.t: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
s: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

ACT.13.37.t: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
s: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

ACT.16.6.t: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.
s: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

ACT.16.7.t: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.
s: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.

ACT.16.8.t: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
s: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

ACT.16.9.t: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”
s: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”

ACT.16.10.t: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.
s: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

ACT.17.10.t: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
s: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

ACT.17.11.t: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
s: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

ACT.17.12.t: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
s: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

ACT.18.24.t: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.
s: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

ACT.18.25.t: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.
s: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

ACT.18.26.t: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
s: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

ACT.18.27.t: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
s: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

ACT.18.28.t: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
s: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

ACT.21.1.t: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
s: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

ACT.21.2.t: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
s: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

ACT.21.3.t: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.
s: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.

ACT.21.4.t: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
s: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

ACT.21.5.t: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.
s: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

ACT.21.6.t: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.
s: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

ACT.23.12.t: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.
s: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

ACT.23.13.t: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.
s: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.

ACT.23.14.t: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
s: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.

ACT.23.15.t: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”
s: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”

ACT.23.16.t: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.
s: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.

ACT.23.17.t: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”
s: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”

ACT.23.18.t: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”
s: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

ACT.23.19.t: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”
s: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

ACT.23.20.t: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.
s: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

ACT.23.21.t: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”
s: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”

ACT.23.22.t: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”
s: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”

ACT.28.1.t: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.
s: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.

ACT.28.2.t: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.
s: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

ACT.28.3.t: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.
s: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

ACT.28.4.t: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”
s: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

ACT.28.5.t: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.
s: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

ACT.28.6.t: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.
s: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

ACT.28.7.t: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.
s: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

ACT.28.8.t: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.
s: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

ACT.28.9.t: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.
s: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.

ACT.28.10.t: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.
s: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

COL.3.1.t: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
s: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

COL.3.2.t: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
s: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

COL.3.3.t: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
s: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

COL.3.4.t: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
s: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

COL.3.8.t: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
s: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

COL.3.9.t: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
s: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

COL.3.10.t: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
s: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

COL.3.11.t: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
s: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

COL.3.12.t: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
s: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

COL.3.13.t: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
s: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

COL.3.14.t: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
s: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

COL.3.15.t: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
s: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

COL.3.16.t: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
s: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

COL.3.17.t: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
s: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

COL.3.22.t: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
s: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

COL.3.23.t: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
s: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

COL.3.24.t: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
s: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

COL.3.25.t: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
s: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

COL.4.1.t: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
s: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

DAN.1.3.t: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:
s: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:

DAN.1.4.t: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.
s: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

DAN.1.5.t: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.
s: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.

DAN.1.6.t: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
s: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

DAN.1.7.t: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
s: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

DAN.1.8.t: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
s: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

DAN.1.9.t: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
s: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.

DAN.1.10.t: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”
s: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”

DAN.1.11.t: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
s: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

DAN.1.12.t: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.
s: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

DAN.1.13.t: Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”
s: Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”

DAN.1.14.t: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.
s: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.

DAN.1.15.t: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.
s: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.

DAN.1.16.t: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.
s: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.

DAN.1.17.t: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
s: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

DAN.3.13.t: Then Nebuchadnezzar in rage and fury commanded that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego be brought. Then these men were brought before the king.
s: Then Nebuchadnezzar in rage and fury commanded that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego be brought. Then these men were brought before the king.

DAN.3.14.t: Nebuchadnezzar answered them, “Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you don’t serve my gods and you don’t worship the golden image which I have set up?
s: Nebuchadnezzar answered them, “Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you don’t serve my gods and you don’t worship the golden image which I have set up?

DAN.3.15.t: Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music to fall down and worship the image which I have made, good; but if you don’t worship, you shall be cast the same hour into the middle of a burning fiery furnace. Who is that god who will deliver you out of my hands?”
s: Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music to fall down and worship the image which I have made, good; but if you don’t worship, you shall be cast the same hour into the middle of a burning fiery furnace. Who is that god who will deliver you out of my hands?”

DAN.3.16.t: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
s: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.

DAN.3.17.t: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.
s: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.

DAN.3.18.t: But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”
s: But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”

DAN.6.1.t: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;
s: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;

DAN.6.2.t: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one, that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss.
s: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one, that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss.

DAN.6.3.t: Then this Daniel was distinguished above the presidents and the local governors, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
s: Then this Daniel was distinguished above the presidents and the local governors, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

DAN.6.4.t: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn’t any error or fault found in him.
s: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn’t any error or fault found in him.

DAN.6.5.t: Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law of his God.”
s: Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law of his God.”

DAN.6.6.t: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live forever!
s: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live forever!

DAN.6.7.t: All the presidents of the kingdom, the deputies and the local governors, the counselors and the governors, have consulted together to establish a royal statute and to make a strong decree, that whoever asks a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
s: All the presidents of the kingdom, the deputies and the local governors, the counselors and the governors, have consulted together to establish a royal statute and to make a strong decree, that whoever asks a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

DAN.6.8.t: Now, O king, establish the decree and sign the writing, that it not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”
s: Now, O king, establish the decree and sign the writing, that it not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”

DAN.6.9.t: Therefore King Darius signed the writing and the decree.
s: Therefore King Darius signed the writing and the decree.

DAN.6.10.t: When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.
s: When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.

DEU.6.4.t: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.
s: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.

DEU.6.5.t: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
s: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

DEU.6.6.t: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
s: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

DEU.6.7.t: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
s: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

DEU.6.8.t: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
s: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

DEU.6.9.t: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.
s: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

DEU.8.6.t: You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
s: You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

DEU.8.7.t: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
s: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;

DEU.8.8.t: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;
s: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;

DEU.8.9.t: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
s: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

DEU.8.10.t: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.
s: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.

DEU.8.11.t: Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;
s: Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

DEU.31.1.t: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
s: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

DEU.31.2.t: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’
s: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

DEU.31.3.t: Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as Yahweh has spoken.
s: Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

DEU.31.4.t: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.
s: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

DEU.31.5.t: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.
s: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

DEU.31.6.t: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
s: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

DEU.33.26.t: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
s: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun,
who rides on the heavens for your help,
in his excellency on the skies.

DEU.33.27.t: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
s: The eternal God is your dwelling place.
Underneath are the everlasting arms.
He thrust out the enemy from before you,
and said, ‘Destroy!’

DEU.33.28.t: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.
s: Israel dwells in safety,
the fountain of Jacob alone,
In a land of grain and new wine.
Yes, his heavens drop down dew.

DEU.33.29.t: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”
s: You are happy, Israel!
Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh,
the shield of your help,
the sword of your excellency?
Your enemies will submit themselves to you.
You will tread on their high places.”

ECC.3.1.t: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
s: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

ECC.3.2.t: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
s: a time to be born,
and a time to die;
a time to plant,
and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

ECC.3.3.t: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
s: a time to kill,
and a time to heal;
a time to break down,
and a time to build up;

ECC.3.4.t: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
s: a time to weep,
and a time to laugh;
a time to mourn,
and a time to dance;

ECC.3.5.t: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
s: a time to cast away stones,
and a time to gather stones together;
a time to embrace,
and a time to refrain from embracing;

ECC.3.6.t: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
s: a time to seek,
and a time to lose;
a time to keep,
and a time to cast away;

ECC.3.7.t: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
s: a time to tear,
and a time to sew;
a time to keep silence,
and a time to speak;

ECC.3.8.t: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
s: a time to love,
and a time to hate;
a time for war,
and a time for peace.

ECC.3.9.t: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?
s: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

ECC.3.10.t: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
s: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

ECC.3.11.t: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
s: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

ECC.4.7.t: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
s: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

ECC.4.8.t: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
s: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

ECC.4.9.t: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
s: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

ECC.4.10.t: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
s: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

ECC.4.11.t: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
s: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

ECC.4.12.t: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
s: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

ECC.9.7.t: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
s: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

ECC.9.8.t: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.
s: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

ECC.9.9.t: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.
s: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

ECC.9.10.t: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
s: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

ECC.9.11.t: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
s: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

ECC.11.1.t: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.
s: Cast your bread on the waters;
for you shall find it after many days.

ECC.11.2.t: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight; for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.
s: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight;
for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.

ECC.11.3.t: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth; and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.
s: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth;
and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north,
in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.

ECC.11.4.t: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.
s: He who observes the wind won’t sow;
and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.

ECC.11.5.t: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don’t know the work of God who does all.
s: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind,
nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child;
even so you don’t know the work of God who does all.

ECC.11.6.t: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both will be equally good.
s: In the morning sow your seed,
and in the evening don’t withhold your hand;
for you don’t know which will prosper, whether this or that,
or whether they both will be equally good.

EPH.2.4.t: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
s: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

EPH.2.5.t: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
s: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

EPH.2.6.t: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
s: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

EPH.2.7.t: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
s: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

EPH.2.8.t: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
s: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

EPH.2.9.t: not of works, that no one would boast.
s: not of works, that no one would boast.

EPH.2.10.t: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
s: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

EPH.3.14.t: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
s: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

EPH.3.15.t: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
s: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

EPH.3.16.t: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,
s: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

EPH.3.17.t: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
s: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

EPH.3.18.t: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,
s: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

EPH.3.19.t: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
s: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

EPH.3.20.t: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
s: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

EPH.3.21.t: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
s: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

EPH.4.1.t: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
s: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

EPH.4.2.t: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
s: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

EPH.4.3.t: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
s: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

EPH.4.4.t: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
s: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

EPH.4.5.t: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
s: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

EPH.4.6.t: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
s: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

EPH.4.20.t: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,
s: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

EPH.4.21.t: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
s: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

EPH.4.22.t: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
s: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

EPH.4.23.t: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
s: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

EPH.4.24.t: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
s: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

EPH.4.25.t: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
s: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

EPH.4.26.t: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
s: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

EPH.4.27.t: and don’t give place to the devil.
s: and don’t give place to the devil.

EPH.4.28.t: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
s: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

EPH.4.29.t: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
s: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

EPH.4.30.t: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
s: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

EPH.4.31.t: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
s: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

EPH.4.32.t: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
s: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

EPH.5.1.t: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
s: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

EPH.5.2.t: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
s: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

EXO.2.1.t: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.
s: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.

EXO.2.2.t: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.
s: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.

EXO.2.3.t: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.
s: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.

EXO.2.4.t: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.
s: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.

EXO.2.5.t: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.
s: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.

EXO.2.6.t: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”
s: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”

EXO.2.7.t: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”
s: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”

EXO.2.8.t: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.
s: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.”
The young woman went and called the child’s mother.

EXO.2.9.t: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed him.
s: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.”
The woman took the child, and nursed him.

EXO.2.10.t: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”
s: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”

EXO.4.10.t: Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”
s: Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”

EXO.4.11.t: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
s: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?

EXO.4.12.t: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
s: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”

EXO.4.13.t: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”
s: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”

EXO.4.14.t: Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he is coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
s: Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he is coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.

EXO.4.15.t: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.
s: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.

EXO.4.16.t: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
s: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.

EXO.4.17.t: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”
s: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”

EXO.17.8.t: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
s: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

EXO.17.9.t: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”
s: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”

EXO.17.10.t: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
s: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

EXO.17.11.t: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
s: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

EXO.17.12.t: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.
s: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.

EXO.17.13.t: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
s: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

EXO.18.13.t: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.
s: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.

EXO.18.14.t: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”
s: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”

EXO.18.15.t: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.
s: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

EXO.18.16.t: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”
s: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”

EXO.18.17.t: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.
s: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.

EXO.18.18.t: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.
s: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

EXO.18.19.t: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.
s: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.

EXO.18.20.t: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.
s: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

EXO.18.21.t: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
s: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

EXO.18.22.t: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.
s: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.

EXO.18.23.t: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”
s: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”

EXO.18.24.t: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
s: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

EXO.31.2.t: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
s: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

EXO.31.3.t: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,
s: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

EXO.31.4.t: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,
s: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

EXO.31.5.t: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.
s: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

EXO.31.6.t: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:
s: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

EXO.33.12.t: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’
s: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

EXO.33.13.t: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”
s: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”

EXO.33.14.t: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
s: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

EXO.33.15.t: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
s: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.

EXO.33.16.t: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”
s: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”

EXO.33.17.t: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”
s: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”

EZR.8.21.t: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, for our little ones, and for all our possessions.
s: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, for our little ones, and for all our possessions.

EZR.8.22.t: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”
s: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”

EZR.8.23.t: So we fasted and begged our God for this, and he granted our request.
s: So we fasted and begged our God for this, and he granted our request.

EZR.8.24.t: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,
s: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

EZR.8.25.t: and weighed to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, his counselors, his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered.
s: and weighed to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, his counselors, his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered.

EZR.8.26.t: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold,
s: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold,

EZR.8.27.t: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.
s: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.

EZR.8.28.t: I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a free will offering to Yahweh, the God of your fathers.
s: I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a free will offering to Yahweh, the God of your fathers.

EZR.8.29.t: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel at Jerusalem, in the rooms of Yahweh’s house.”
s: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel at Jerusalem, in the rooms of Yahweh’s house.”
