s: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

JHN.20.25.t: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
s: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!”
But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

JHN.20.26.t: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
s: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

JHN.20.27.t: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
s: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

JHN.20.28.t: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
s: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

JHN.20.29.t: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
s: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

JHN.20.30.t: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
s: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

JHN.20.31.t: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
s: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

JHN.21.9.t: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
s: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

JHN.21.10.t: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
s: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

JHN.21.11.t: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
s: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

JHN.21.12.t: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
s: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!”
None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

JHN.21.13.t: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
s: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

JHN.21.14.t: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
s: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

JHN.21.15.t: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
s: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?”
He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”
He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

JHN.21.16.t: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
s: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?”
He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”
He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

JHN.21.17.t: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
s: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?”
Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.”
Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

JOB.2.7.t: So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
s: So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

JOB.2.8.t: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.
s: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

JOB.2.9.t: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”
s: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

JOB.2.10.t: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.
s: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?”
In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

JOB.2.11.t: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.
s: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

JOB.2.12.t: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.
s: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

JOB.2.13.t: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.
s: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

JON.3.1.t: Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,
s: Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,

JON.3.2.t: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
s: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”

JON.3.3.t: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to Yahweh’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.
s: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to Yahweh’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.

JON.3.4.t: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”
s: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”

JON.3.5.t: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.
s: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.

JOS.1.1.t: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,
s: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,

JOS.1.2.t: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.
s: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.

JOS.1.3.t: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.
s: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.

JOS.1.4.t: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.
s: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

JOS.1.5.t: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.
s: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

JOS.1.6.t: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.
s: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

JOS.1.7.t: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.
s: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.

JOS.1.8.t: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
s: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

JOS.1.9.t: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
s: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”

JOS.3.1.t: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.
s: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.

JOS.3.2.t: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;
s: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;

JOS.3.3.t: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, and the Levitical priests bearing it, then leave your place and follow it.
s: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, and the Levitical priests bearing it, then leave your place and follow it.

JOS.3.4.t: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”
s: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”

JOS.3.5.t: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you.”
s: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you.”

JOS.3.6.t: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
s: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

JOS.24.14.t: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.
s: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.

JOS.24.15.t: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”
s: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”

JOS.24.16.t: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;
s: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;

JOS.24.17.t: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.
s: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

JOS.24.18.t: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”
s: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”

LAM.3.19.t: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
s: Remember my affliction and my misery,
the wormwood and the bitterness.

LAM.3.20.t: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
s: My soul still remembers them,
and is bowed down within me.

LAM.3.21.t: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
s: This I recall to my mind;
therefore I have hope.

LAM.3.22.t: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

s: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;

s: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

s: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

s: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

s: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

s: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

s: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

s: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

s: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?”
He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

s: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

LUK.6.28.t: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
s: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

s: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

s: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

s: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

s: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

s: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

s: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

s: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

s: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

s: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

s: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.”

for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us.

s: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

s: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.

s: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

s: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

s: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

s: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

s: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!

s: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

s: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.

s: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

s: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

s: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;

s: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

s: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.

s: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

s: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.

s: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

s: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’

s: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

MAT.7.20.t: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
s: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

MAT.7.24.t: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.
s: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

MAT.7.25.t: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
s: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

MAT.7.26.t: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
s: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

MAT.7.27.t: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”
s: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

MAT.9.35.t: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
s: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

MAT.9.36.t: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
s: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

MAT.9.37.t: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
s: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

MAT.9.38.t: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
s: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

MAT.11.25.t: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.
s: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

MAT.11.26.t: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
s: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

MAT.11.27.t: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.
s: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

MAT.11.28.t: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
s: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

MAT.11.29.t: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
s: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

MAT.11.30.t: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
s: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

MAT.14.22.t: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
s: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

MAT.14.23.t: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
s: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

MAT.14.24.t: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
s: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

MAT.14.25.t: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.
s: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

MAT.14.26.t: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.
s: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

MAT.14.27.t: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
s: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

MAT.14.28.t: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
s: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

MAT.14.29.t: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.
s: He said, “Come!”
Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

MAT.14.30.t: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
s: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

MAT.14.31.t: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
s: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

MAT.14.32.t: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
s: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

MAT.14.33.t: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
s: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

MAT.18.12.t: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?
s: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

MAT.18.13.t: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
s: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

MAT.18.14.t: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
s: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

MAT.18.15.t: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
s: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

MAT.18.16.t: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
s: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

MAT.18.17.t: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.
s: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

MAT.18.18.t: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
s: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

MAT.18.19.t: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
s: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

MAT.18.20.t: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
s: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

MAT.18.21.t: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
s: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

MAT.18.22.t: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
s: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

MAT.25.14.t: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.
s: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

MAT.25.15.t: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
s: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

MAT.25.16.t: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
s: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

MAT.25.17.t: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
s: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

MAT.25.18.t: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.
s: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

MAT.25.19.t: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.
s: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

MAT.25.20.t: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’
s: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

MAT.25.21.t: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
s: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

MAT.25.22.t: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’
s: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

MAT.25.23.t: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
s: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

MAT.25.24.t: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.
s: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

MAT.25.25.t: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
s: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

MAT.25.26.t: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
s: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

MAT.25.27.t: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
s: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

MAT.25.28.t: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.
s: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

MAT.25.29.t: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.
s: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

MAT.25.30.t: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
s: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

MAT.26.36.t: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”
s: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

MAT.26.37.t: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
s: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

MAT.26.38.t: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”
s: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

MAT.26.39.t: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
s: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

MAT.26.40.t: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
s: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

MAT.26.41.t: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
s: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

MAT.26.42.t: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”
s: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

MAT.26.43.t: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
s: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

MAT.26.44.t: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.
s: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

MAT.26.45.t: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
s: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

MAT.26.46.t: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
s: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

MIC.6.1.t: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
s: Listen now to what Yahweh says:
“Arise, plead your case before the mountains,
and let the hills hear what you have to say.

MIC.6.2.t: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.
s: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s indictment,
and you enduring foundations of the earth;
for Yahweh has a case against his people,
and he will contend with Israel.

MIC.6.3.t: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
s: My people, what have I done to you?
How have I burdened you?
Answer me!

MIC.6.4.t: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
s: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt,
and redeemed you out of the house of bondage.
I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

MIC.6.5.t: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”
s: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised,
and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal,
that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”

MIC.6.6.t: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
s: How shall I come before Yahweh,
and bow myself before the exalted God?
Shall I come before him with burnt offerings,
with calves a year old?

MIC.6.7.t: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
s: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams?
With tens of thousands of rivers of oil?
Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience?
The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

MIC.6.8.t: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
s: He has shown you, O man, what is good.
What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly,
to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

MIC.7.18.t: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
s: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity,
and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage?
He doesn’t retain his anger forever,
because he delights in loving kindness.

MIC.7.19.t: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
s: He will again have compassion on us.
He will tread our iniquities under foot.
You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

MIC.7.20.t: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
s: You will give truth to Jacob,
and mercy to Abraham,
as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.

MRK.1.40.t: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
s: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

MRK.1.41.t: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
s: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

MRK.1.42.t: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.
s: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

MRK.1.43.t: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,
s: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

MRK.1.44.t: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
s: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

MRK.1.45.t: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.
s: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

MRK.2.1.t: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.
s: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

MRK.2.2.t: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.
s: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

MRK.2.3.t: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
s: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

MRK.2.4.t: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.
s: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

MRK.2.5.t: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
s: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

MRK.2.6.t: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
s: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

MRK.2.7.t: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
s: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

MRK.2.8.t: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?
s: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

MRK.2.9.t: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?
s: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

MRK.2.10.t: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—
s: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

MRK.2.11.t: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
s: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

MRK.2.12.t: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”
s: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

MRK.4.30.t: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
s: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

MRK.4.31.t: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
s: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

MRK.4.32.t: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”
s: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

MRK.4.33.t: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
s: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

MRK.4.34.t: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
s: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

MRK.4.35.t: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”
s: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

MRK.4.36.t: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
s: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

MRK.4.37.t: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
s: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

MRK.4.38.t: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
s: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

MRK.4.39.t: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.
s: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

MRK.4.40.t: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
s: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

MRK.4.41.t: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
s: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

MRK.5.15.t: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.
s: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

MRK.5.16.t: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
s: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

MRK.5.17.t: They began to beg him to depart from their region.
s: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

MRK.5.18.t: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
s: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

MRK.5.19.t: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”
s: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

MRK.5.20.t: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
s: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

MRK.6.30.t: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
s: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

MRK.6.31.t: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
s: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

MRK.6.32.t: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
s: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

MRK.6.33.t: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
s: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

MRK.6.34.t: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
s: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

MRK.6.45.t: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.
s: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

MRK.6.46.t: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
s: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

MRK.6.47.t: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
s: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

MRK.6.48.t: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,
s: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,

MRK.6.49.t: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
s: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

MRK.6.50.t: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
s: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

MRK.6.51.t: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
s: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

MRK.7.31.t: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.
s: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

MRK.7.32.t: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
s: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

MRK.7.33.t: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.
s: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.

MRK.7.34.t: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”
s: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

MRK.7.35.t: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
s: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

MRK.7.36.t: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.
s: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

MRK.7.37.t: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
s: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

MRK.9.20.t: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.
s: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

MRK.9.21.t: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.
s: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?”
He said, “From childhood.

MRK.9.22.t: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
s: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

MRK.9.23.t: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
s: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

MRK.9.24.t: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
s: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

MRK.9.25.t: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”
s: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

MRK.9.26.t: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”
s: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

MRK.9.27.t: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.
s: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

MRK.10.13.t: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.
s: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

MRK.10.14.t: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
s: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

MRK.10.15.t: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
s: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

MRK.10.16.t: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
s: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

MRK.10.35.t: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
s: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

MRK.10.36.t: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
s: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

MRK.10.37.t: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”
s: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

MRK.10.38.t: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
s: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

MRK.10.39.t: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;
s: They said to him, “We are able.”
Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

MRK.10.40.t: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”
s: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

MRK.10.41.t: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.
s: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

MRK.10.42.t: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
s: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

MRK.10.43.t: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.
s: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

MRK.10.44.t: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.
s: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

MRK.10.45.t: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
s: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

MRK.10.46.t: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.
s: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

MRK.10.47.t: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
s: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

MRK.10.48.t: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
s: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

MRK.10.49.t: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”
s: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.”
They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

MRK.10.50.t: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
s: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

MRK.10.51.t: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”
s: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?”
The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

MRK.10.52.t: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.
s: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

NEH.2.11.t: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
s: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

NEH.2.12.t: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.
s: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.

NEH.2.13.t: I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.
s: I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.

NEH.2.14.t: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.
s: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.

NEH.2.15.t: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.
s: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.

NEH.2.16.t: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did. I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.
s: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did. I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.

NEH.2.17.t: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”
s: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”

NEH.2.18.t: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They said, “Let’s rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.
s: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me.
They said, “Let’s rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.

NEH.4.1.t: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.
s: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.

NEH.4.2.t: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”
s: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”

NEH.4.3.t: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”
s: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”

NEH.4.4.t: “Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity.
s: “Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity.

NEH.4.5.t: Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”
s: Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”

NEH.4.6.t: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.
s: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.

NEH.4.7.t: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry;
s: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry;

NEH.4.8.t: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.
s: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.

NEH.4.9.t: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night because of them.
s: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night because of them.

NEH.6.1.t: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),
s: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),

NEH.6.2.t: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.
s: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.

NEH.6.3.t: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”
s: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”

NEH.6.4.t: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.
s: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.
Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

NUM.6.23.t: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,
s: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,
‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you.

NUM.6.25.t: Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
s: Yahweh make his face to shine on you,
and be gracious to you.

NUM.6.26.t: Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’
s: Yahweh lift up his face toward you,
and give you peace.’

NUM.6.27.t: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”
s: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

PHP.1.3.t: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
s: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

PHP.1.4.t: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
s: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

PHP.1.5.t: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
s: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

PHP.1.6.t: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
s: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

PHP.1.7.t: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
s: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

PHP.1.8.t: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
s: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

PHP.1.9.t: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
s: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

PHP.1.10.t: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
s: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

PHP.1.11.t: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
s: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

PHP.2.1.t: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
s: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

PHP.2.2.t: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
s: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

PHP.2.3.t: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
s: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

PHP.2.4.t: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
s: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

PHP.2.5.t: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
s: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

PHP.2.6.t: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
s: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

PHP.2.7.t: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
s: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

PHP.2.8.t: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
s: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

PHP.2.9.t: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
s: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

PHP.2.10.t: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
s: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

PHP.2.11.t: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
s: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

PHP.3.12.t: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
s: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

PHP.3.13.t: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,
s: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

PHP.3.14.t: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
s: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

PHP.3.15.t: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
s: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

PHP.3.16.t: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
s: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

PHP.4.4.t: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
s: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

PHP.4.5.t: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
s: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

PHP.4.6.t: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
s: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

PHP.4.7.t: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
s: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

PHP.4.8.t: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
s: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

PHP.4.9.t: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
s: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

PHP.4.10.t: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
s: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

PHP.4.11.t: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
s: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

PHP.4.12.t: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
s: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

PHP.4.13.t: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
s: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

PHP.4.14.t: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
s: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

PRO.1.1.t: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
s: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

PRO.1.2.t: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
s: to know wisdom and instruction;
to discern the words of understanding;

PRO.1.3.t: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
s: to receive instruction in wise dealing,
in righteousness, justice, and equity;

PRO.1.4.t: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
s: to give prudence to the simple,
knowledge and discretion to the young man—

PRO.1.5.t: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;
s: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning;
that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

PRO.1.6.t: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
s: to understand a proverb and parables,
the words and riddles of the wise.

PRO.1.7.t: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
s: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge,
but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

PRO.1.8.t: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
s: My son, listen to your father’s instruction,
and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

PRO.1.9.t: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
s: for they will be a garland to grace your head,
and chains around your neck.

PRO.1.10.t: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
s: My son, if sinners entice you,
don’t consent.

PRO.1.11.t: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
s: If they say, “Come with us.
Let’s lie in wait for blood.
Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

PRO.1.12.t: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
s: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol,
and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

PRO.1.13.t: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
s: We’ll find all valuable wealth.
We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

PRO.1.14.t: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—
s: You shall cast your lot among us.
We’ll all have one purse”—

PRO.1.15.t: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
s: my son, don’t walk on the path with them.
Keep your foot from their path,

PRO.2.1.t: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
s: My son, if you will receive my words,
and store up my commandments within you,
