PSA.61.2.t: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
s: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed.
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

PSA.61.3.t: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
s: For you have been a refuge for me,
a strong tower from the enemy.

PSA.61.4.t: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
s: I will dwell in your tent forever.
I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

PSA.61.5.t: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
s: For you, God, have heard my vows.
You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

PSA.61.6.t: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.
s: You will prolong the king’s life.
His years will be for generations.

PSA.61.7.t: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
s: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever.
Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

PSA.61.8.t: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
s: So I will sing praise to your name forever,
that I may fulfill my vows daily.

PSA.62.1.t: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
s: My soul rests in God alone.
My salvation is from him.
PSA.62.1.h: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David.

PSA.62.2.t: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
s: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress.
I will never be greatly shaken.

PSA.62.3.t: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
s: How long will you assault a man?
Would all of you throw him down,
like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

PSA.62.4.t: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
s: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place.
They delight in lies.
They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

PSA.62.5.t: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
s: My soul, wait in silence for God alone,
for my expectation is from him.

PSA.62.6.t: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
s: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress.
I will not be shaken.

PSA.62.7.t: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
s: My salvation and my honor is with God.
The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

PSA.62.8.t: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
s: Trust in him at all times, you people.
Pour out your heart before him.
God is a refuge for us. Selah.

PSA.62.9.t: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
s: Surely men of low degree are just a breath,
and men of high degree are a lie.
In the balances they will go up.
They are together lighter than a breath.

PSA.62.10.t: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
s: Don’t trust in oppression.
Don’t become vain in robbery.
If riches increase,
don’t set your heart on them.

PSA.62.11.t: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
s: God has spoken once;
twice I have heard this,
that power belongs to God.

PSA.62.12.t: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
s: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness,
for you reward every man according to his work.

PSA.63.1.t: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
s: God, you are my God.
I will earnestly seek you.
My soul thirsts for you.
My flesh longs for you,
in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
PSA.63.1.h: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah.

PSA.63.2.t: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
s: So I have seen you in the sanctuary,
watching your power and your glory.

PSA.63.3.t: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
s: Because your loving kindness is better than life,
my lips shall praise you.

PSA.63.4.t: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
s: So I will bless you while I live.
I will lift up my hands in your name.

PSA.63.5.t: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
s: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food.
My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

PSA.63.6.t: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
s: when I remember you on my bed,
and think about you in the night watches.

PSA.63.7.t: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
s: For you have been my help.
I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

PSA.63.8.t: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
s: My soul stays close to you.
Your right hand holds me up.

PSA.65.9.t: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
s: You visit the earth, and water it.
You greatly enrich it.
The river of God is full of water.
You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

PSA.65.10.t: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
s: You drench its furrows.
You level its ridges.
You soften it with showers.
You bless it with a crop.

PSA.65.11.t: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
s: You crown the year with your bounty.
Your carts overflow with abundance.

PSA.65.12.t: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.
s: The wilderness grasslands overflow.
The hills are clothed with gladness.

PSA.65.13.t: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.
s: The pastures are covered with flocks.
The valleys also are clothed with grain.
They shout for joy!
They also sing.

PSA.68.3.t: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
s: But let the righteous be glad.
Let them rejoice before God.
Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

PSA.68.4.t: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
s: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name!
Extol him who rides on the clouds:
to Yah, his name!
Rejoice before him!

PSA.68.5.t: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
s: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows,
is God in his holy habitation.

PSA.68.6.t: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
s: God sets the lonely in families.
He brings out the prisoners with singing,
but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

PSA.68.7.t: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
s: God, when you went out before your people,
when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

PSA.68.8.t: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
s: The earth trembled.
The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai—
at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

PSA.68.9.t: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
s: You, God, sent a plentiful rain.
You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

PSA.68.10.t: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
s: Your congregation lived therein.
You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

PSA.68.15.t: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
s: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains.
The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

PSA.68.16.t: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.
s: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains,
at the mountain where God chooses to reign?
Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.

PSA.68.17.t: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
s: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands.
The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

PSA.68.18.t: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.
s: You have ascended on high.
You have led away captives.
You have received gifts among people,
yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.

PSA.68.19.t: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
s: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens,
even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

PSA.68.20.t: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
s: God is to us a God of deliverance.
To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

PSA.71.1.t: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
s: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge.
Never let me be disappointed.

PSA.71.2.t: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
s: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me.
Turn your ear to me, and save me.

PSA.71.3.t: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
s: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go.
Give the command to save me,
for you are my rock and my fortress.

PSA.71.4.t: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
s: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked,
from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

PSA.71.5.t: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.
s: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh,
my confidence from my youth.

PSA.71.6.t: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
s: I have relied on you from the womb.
You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb.
I will always praise you.

PSA.71.7.t: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
s: I am a marvel to many,
but you are my strong refuge.

PSA.71.8.t: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
s: My mouth shall be filled with your praise,
with your honor all day long.

PSA.71.9.t: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
s: Don’t reject me in my old age.
Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

PSA.73.21.t: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
s: For my soul was grieved.
I was embittered in my heart.

PSA.73.22.t: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
s: I was so senseless and ignorant.
I was a brute beast before you.

PSA.73.23.t: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
s: Nevertheless, I am continually with you.
You have held my right hand.

PSA.73.24.t: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
s: You will guide me with your counsel,
and afterward receive me to glory.

PSA.73.25.t: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
s: Whom do I have in heaven?
There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

PSA.73.26.t: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
s: My flesh and my heart fails,
but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

PSA.73.27.t: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
s: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish.
You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

PSA.73.28.t: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
s: But it is good for me to come close to God.
I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge,
that I may tell of all your works.

PSA.85.1.t: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
s: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land.
You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
PSA.85.1.h: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

PSA.85.2.t: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.
s: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people.
You have covered all their sin. Selah.

PSA.85.3.t: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
s: You have taken away all your wrath.
You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

PSA.85.4.t: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
s: Turn us, God of our salvation,
and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

PSA.85.5.t: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
s: Will you be angry with us forever?
Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

PSA.85.6.t: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
s: Won’t you revive us again,
that your people may rejoice in you?

PSA.85.7.t: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.
s: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh.
Grant us your salvation.

PSA.85.8.t: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
s: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak,
for he will speak peace to his people, his saints;
but let them not turn again to folly.

PSA.85.9.t: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
s: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him,
that glory may dwell in our land.

PSA.85.10.t: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
s: Mercy and truth meet together.
Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

PSA.85.11.t: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
s: Truth springs out of the earth.
Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

PSA.85.12.t: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
s: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good.
Our land will yield its increase.

PSA.85.13.t: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.
s: Righteousness goes before him,
and prepares the way for his steps.

PSA.86.1.t: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
s: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me,
for I am poor and needy.

PSA.86.2.t: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
s: Preserve my soul, for I am godly.
You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

PSA.86.3.t: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
s: Be merciful to me, Lord,
for I call to you all day long.

PSA.86.4.t: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
s: Bring joy to the soul of your servant,
for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

PSA.86.5.t: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
s: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive,
abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

PSA.86.6.t: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
s: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer.
Listen to the voice of my petitions.

PSA.86.7.t: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
s: In the day of my trouble I will call on you,
for you will answer me.

PSA.86.8.t: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
s: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord,
nor any deeds like your deeds.

PSA.86.9.t: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
s: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord.
They shall glorify your name.

PSA.86.10.t: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
s: For you are great, and do wondrous things.
You are God alone.

PSA.86.11.t: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
s: Teach me your way, Yahweh.
I will walk in your truth.
Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

PSA.86.12.t: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
s: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart.
I will glorify your name forever more.

PSA.86.13.t: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
s: For your loving kindness is great toward me.
You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

PSA.90.1.t: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
s: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
PSA.90.1.h: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God.

PSA.90.2.t: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
s: Before the mountains were born,
before you had formed the earth and the world,
even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

PSA.90.3.t: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
s: You turn man to destruction, saying,
“Return, you children of men.”

PSA.90.4.t: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
s: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past,
like a watch in the night.

PSA.90.5.t: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
s: You sweep them away as they sleep.
In the morning they sprout like new grass.

PSA.90.6.t: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
s: In the morning it sprouts and springs up.
By evening, it is withered and dry.

PSA.90.7.t: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
s: For we are consumed in your anger.
We are troubled in your wrath.

PSA.90.8.t: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
s: You have set our iniquities before you,
our secret sins in the light of your presence.

PSA.90.9.t: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
s: For all our days have passed away in your wrath.
We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

PSA.90.10.t: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
s: The days of our years are seventy,
or even by reason of strength eighty years;
yet their pride is but labor and sorrow,
for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

PSA.90.11.t: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
s: Who knows the power of your anger,
your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

PSA.90.12.t: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
s: So teach us to count our days,
that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

PSA.90.13.t: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
s: Relent, Yahweh!
How long?
Have compassion on your servants!

PSA.90.14.t: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
s: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness,
that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

PSA.90.15.t: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
s: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us,
for as many years as we have seen evil.

PSA.90.16.t: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
s: Let your work appear to your servants,
your glory to their children.

PSA.90.17.t: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
s: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us.
Establish the work of our hands for us.
Yes, establish the work of our hands.

PSA.91.1.t: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
s: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High
will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

PSA.91.2.t: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
s: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress;
my God, in whom I trust.”

PSA.91.3.t: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
s: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler,
and from the deadly pestilence.

PSA.91.4.t: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
s: He will cover you with his feathers.
Under his wings you will take refuge.
His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

PSA.92.1.t: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
s: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh,
to sing praises to your name, Most High,
PSA.92.1.h: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.

PSA.92.2.t: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
s: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning,
and your faithfulness every night,

PSA.92.3.t: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
s: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp,
and with the melody of the lyre.

PSA.92.4.t: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
s: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work.
I will triumph in the works of your hands.

PSA.92.5.t: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
s: How great are your works, Yahweh!
Your thoughts are very deep.

PSA.94.16.t: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
s: Who will rise up for me against the wicked?
Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

PSA.94.17.t: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
s: Unless Yahweh had been my help,
my soul would have soon lived in silence.

PSA.94.18.t: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
s: When I said, “My foot is slipping!”
Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.

PSA.94.19.t: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
s: In the multitude of my thoughts within me,
your comforts delight my soul.

PSA.94.20.t: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
s: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you,
which brings about mischief by statute?

PSA.94.21.t: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
s: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous,
and condemn the innocent blood.

PSA.94.22.t: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
s: But Yahweh has been my high tower,
my God, the rock of my refuge.

PSA.100.1.t: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
s: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

PSA.100.2.t: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
s: Serve Yahweh with gladness.
Come before his presence with singing.

PSA.100.3.t: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
s: Know that Yahweh, he is God.
It is he who has made us, and we are his.
We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

PSA.100.4.t: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
s: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
and into his courts with praise.
Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

PSA.100.5.t: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
s: For Yahweh is good.
His loving kindness endures forever,
his faithfulness to all generations.

PSA.102.1.t: Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
s: Hear my prayer, Yahweh!
Let my cry come to you.
PSA.102.1.h: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before Yahweh.

PSA.102.2.t: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
s: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress.
Turn your ear to me.
Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

PSA.102.3.t: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
s: For my days consume away like smoke.
My bones are burned as a torch.

PSA.102.4.t: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
s: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered,
for I forget to eat my bread.

PSA.102.5.t: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
s: By reason of the voice of my groaning,
my bones stick to my skin.

PSA.102.6.t: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
s: I am like a pelican of the wilderness.
I have become as an owl of the waste places.

PSA.102.7.t: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
s: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

PSA.102.8.t: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
s: My enemies reproach me all day.
Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

PSA.102.9.t: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
s: For I have eaten ashes like bread,
and mixed my drink with tears,

PSA.102.10.t: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
s: because of your indignation and your wrath;
for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

PSA.102.11.t: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
s: My days are like a long shadow.
I have withered like grass.

PSA.102.12.t: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
s: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever;
your renown endures to all generations.

PSA.103.1.t: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
s: Praise Yahweh, my soul!
All that is within me, praise his holy name!

PSA.103.2.t: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
s: Praise Yahweh, my soul,
and don’t forget all his benefits,

PSA.103.3.t: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
s: who forgives all your sins,
who heals all your diseases,

PSA.103.4.t: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
s: who redeems your life from destruction,
who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

PSA.103.5.t: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
s: who satisfies your desire with good things,
so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

PSA.103.8.t: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
s: Yahweh is merciful and gracious,
slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

PSA.103.9.t: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
s: He will not always accuse;
neither will he stay angry forever.

PSA.103.10.t: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
s: He has not dealt with us according to our sins,
nor repaid us for our iniquities.

PSA.103.11.t: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
s: For as the heavens are high above the earth,
so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

PSA.103.12.t: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
s: As far as the east is from the west,
so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

PSA.103.13.t: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
s: Like a father has compassion on his children,
so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

PSA.103.14.t: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
s: For he knows how we are made.
He remembers that we are dust.

PSA.103.15.t: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
s: As for man, his days are like grass.
As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

PSA.103.16.t: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
s: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone.
Its place remembers it no more.

PSA.103.17.t: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
s: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him,
his righteousness to children’s children,

PSA.103.18.t: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
s: to those who keep his covenant,
to those who remember to obey his precepts.

PSA.107.23.t: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,
s: Those who go down to the sea in ships,
who do business in great waters,

PSA.107.24.t: these see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
s: these see Yahweh’s deeds,
and his wonders in the deep.

PSA.107.25.t: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
s: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind,
which lifts up its waves.

PSA.107.26.t: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
s: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths.
Their soul melts away because of trouble.

PSA.107.27.t: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
s: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man,
and are at their wits’ end.

PSA.107.28.t: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
s: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble,
and he brings them out of their distress.

PSA.107.29.t: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
s: He makes the storm a calm,
so that its waves are still.

PSA.107.30.t: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
s: Then they are glad because it is calm,
so he brings them to their desired haven.

PSA.107.31.t: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
s: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness,
for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

PSA.107.32.t: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
s: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people,
and praise him in the seat of the elders.

PSA.111.1.t: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
s: Praise Yah!
I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart,
in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

PSA.111.2.t: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
s: Yahweh’s works are great,
pondered by all those who delight in them.

PSA.111.3.t: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
s: His work is honor and majesty.
His righteousness endures forever.

PSA.111.4.t: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
s: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered.
Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

PSA.111.5.t: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
s: He has given food to those who fear him.
He always remembers his covenant.

PSA.111.6.t: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
s: He has shown his people the power of his works,
in giving them the heritage of the nations.

PSA.111.7.t: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
s: The works of his hands are truth and justice.
All his precepts are sure.

PSA.111.8.t: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
s: They are established forever and ever.
They are done in truth and uprightness.

PSA.111.9.t: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
s: He has sent redemption to his people.
He has ordained his covenant forever.
His name is holy and awesome!

PSA.111.10.t: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
s: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom.
All those who do his work have a good understanding.
His praise endures forever!

PSA.116.1.t: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
s: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice,
and my cries for mercy.

PSA.116.2.t: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
s: Because he has turned his ear to me,
therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

PSA.116.3.t: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
s: The cords of death surrounded me,
the pains of Sheol got a hold of me.
I found trouble and sorrow.

PSA.116.4.t: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
s: Then I called on Yahweh’s name:
“Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

PSA.116.5.t: Yahweh is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
s: Yahweh is gracious and righteous.
Yes, our God is merciful.

PSA.116.6.t: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
s: Yahweh preserves the simple.
I was brought low, and he saved me.

PSA.116.7.t: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
s: Return to your rest, my soul,
for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.

PSA.116.8.t: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
s: For you have delivered my soul from death,
my eyes from tears,
and my feet from falling.

PSA.116.9.t: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.
s: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

PSA.118.19.t: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
s: Open to me the gates of righteousness.
I will enter into them.
I will give thanks to Yah.

PSA.118.20.t: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
s: This is the gate of Yahweh;
the righteous will enter into it.

PSA.118.21.t: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
s: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me,
and have become my salvation.

PSA.118.22.t: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
s: The stone which the builders rejected
has become the cornerstone.

PSA.118.23.t: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
s: This is Yahweh’s doing.
It is marvelous in our eyes.

PSA.118.24.t: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
s: This is the day that Yahweh has made.
We will rejoice and be glad in it!

PSA.118.25.t: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
s: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh!
Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.

PSA.118.26.t: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
s: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name!
We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.

PSA.118.27.t: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
s: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light.
Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

PSA.118.28.t: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
s: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you.
You are my God, I will exalt you.

PSA.118.29.t: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
s: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good,
for his loving kindness endures forever.

PSA.119.9.t: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
s: How can a young man keep his way pure?
By living according to your word.

PSA.119.10.t: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
s: With my whole heart I have sought you.
Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

PSA.119.11.t: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
s: I have hidden your word in my heart,
that I might not sin against you.

PSA.119.12.t: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
s: Blessed are you, Yahweh.
Teach me your statutes.

PSA.119.13.t: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
s: With my lips,
I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

PSA.119.14.t: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
s: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies,
as much as in all riches.

PSA.119.15.t: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
s: I will meditate on your precepts,
and consider your ways.

PSA.119.16.t: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
s: I will delight myself in your statutes.
I will not forget your word.

PSA.119.33.t: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
s: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes.
I will keep them to the end.

PSA.119.34.t: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
s: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law.
Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

PSA.119.35.t: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
s: Direct me in the path of your commandments,
for I delight in them.

PSA.119.36.t: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
s: Turn my heart toward your statutes,
not toward selfish gain.

PSA.119.37.t: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
s: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things.
Revive me in your ways.

PSA.119.38.t: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
s: Fulfill your promise to your servant,
that you may be feared.

PSA.119.39.t: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
s: Take away my disgrace that I dread,
for your ordinances are good.

PSA.119.40.t: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
s: Behold, I long for your precepts!
Revive me in your righteousness.

PSA.119.97.t: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
s: How I love your law!
It is my meditation all day.

PSA.119.98.t: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
s: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies,
for your commandments are always with me.

PSA.119.99.t: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
s: I have more understanding than all my teachers,
for your testimonies are my meditation.

PSA.119.100.t: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
s: I understand more than the aged,
because I have kept your precepts.

PSA.119.101.t: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
s: I have kept my feet from every evil way,
that I might observe your word.

PSA.119.102.t: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
s: I have not turned away from your ordinances,
for you have taught me.

PSA.119.103.t: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
s: How sweet are your promises to my taste,
more than honey to my mouth!

PSA.119.104.t: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
s: Through your precepts, I get understanding;
therefore I hate every false way.

PSA.119.105.t: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
s: Your word is a lamp to my feet,
and a light for my path.

PSA.119.106.t: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
s: I have sworn, and have confirmed it,
that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

PSA.119.107.t: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
s: I am afflicted very much.
Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.

PSA.119.108.t: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.
s: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth.
Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.

PSA.119.109.t: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
s: My soul is continually in my hand,
yet I won’t forget your law.

PSA.119.110.t: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
s: The wicked have laid a snare for me,
yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

PSA.119.111.t: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
s: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever,
for they are the joy of my heart.

PSA.119.112.t: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.
s: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever,
even to the end.

PSA.121.1.t: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
s: I will lift up my eyes to the hills.
Where does my help come from?

PSA.121.2.t: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
s: My help comes from Yahweh,
who made heaven and earth.

PSA.121.3.t: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
s: He will not allow your foot to be moved.
He who keeps you will not slumber.

PSA.121.4.t: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
s: Behold, he who keeps Israel
will neither slumber nor sleep.

PSA.121.5.t: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
s: Yahweh is your keeper.
Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

PSA.121.6.t: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
s: The sun will not harm you by day,
nor the moon by night.

PSA.121.7.t: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
s: Yahweh will keep you from all evil.
He will keep your soul.

PSA.121.8.t: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
s: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in,
from this time forward, and forever more.

PSA.127.1.t: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
s: Unless Yahweh builds the house,
they who build it labor in vain.
Unless Yahweh watches over the city,
the watchman guards it in vain.
PSA.127.1.h: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon.

PSA.127.2.t: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
s: It is vain for you to rise up early,
to stay up late,
eating the bread of toil,
for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

PSA.127.3.t: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
s: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh.
The fruit of the womb is his reward.

PSA.127.4.t: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
s: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man,
so are the children of youth.

PSA.127.5.t: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
s: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them.
They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

PSA.131.1.t: Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
s: Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty;
nor do I concern myself with great matters,
or things too wonderful for me.
PSA.131.1.h: A Song of Ascents. By David.

PSA.131.2.t: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
s: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul,
like a weaned child with his mother,
like a weaned child is my soul within me.

PSA.131.3.t: Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.
s: Israel, hope in Yahweh,
from this time forward and forever more.

PSA.133.1.t: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
s: See how good and how pleasant it is
for brothers to live together in unity!
PSA.133.1.h: A Song of Ascents. By David.

PSA.133.2.t: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
s: It is like the precious oil on the head,
that ran down on the beard,
even Aaron’s beard,
that came down on the edge of his robes,

PSA.133.3.t: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.
s: like the dew of Hermon,
that comes down on the hills of Zion;
for there Yahweh gives the blessing,
even life forever more.

PSA.138.1.t: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
s: I will give you thanks with my whole heart.
Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

PSA.138.2.t: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
s: I will bow down toward your holy temple,
and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth;
for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

PSA.138.3.t: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
s: In the day that I called, you answered me.
You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

PSA.138.4.t: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
s: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh,
for they have heard the words of your mouth.

PSA.138.5.t: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, for Yahweh’s glory is great!
s: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh,
for Yahweh’s glory is great!

PSA.138.6.t: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
s: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly;
but he knows the proud from afar.

PSA.138.7.t: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
s: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me.
You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies.
Your right hand will save me.

PSA.138.8.t: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
s: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me.
Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever.
Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

PSA.139.1.t: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
s: Yahweh, you have searched me,
and you know me.
PSA.139.1.h: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

PSA.139.2.t: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
s: You know my sitting down and my rising up.
You perceive my thoughts from afar.

PSA.139.3.t: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
s: You search out my path and my lying down,
and are acquainted with all my ways.

PSA.139.4.t: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.
s: For there is not a word on my tongue,
but behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.

PSA.139.5.t: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
s: You hem me in behind and before.
You laid your hand on me.

PSA.139.6.t: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
s: This knowledge is beyond me.
It’s lofty.
I can’t attain it.

PSA.139.7.t: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
s: Where could I go from your Spirit?
Or where could I flee from your presence?

PSA.139.8.t: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
s: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there.
If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

PSA.139.9.t: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
s: If I take the wings of the dawn,
and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

PSA.139.10.t: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
s: even there your hand will lead me,
and your right hand will hold me.

PSA.139.11.t: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
s: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me.
The light around me will be night,”

PSA.139.12.t: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
s: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you,
but the night shines as the day.
The darkness is like light to you.

PSA.139.13.t: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
s: For you formed my inmost being.
You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

PSA.139.14.t: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
s: I will give thanks to you,
for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
Your works are wonderful.
My soul knows that very well.

PSA.139.15.t: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
s: My frame wasn’t hidden from you,
when I was made in secret,
woven together in the depths of the earth.

PSA.139.16.t: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
s: Your eyes saw my body.
In your book they were all written,
the days that were ordained for me,
when as yet there were none of them.

PSA.139.17.t: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
s: How precious to me are your thoughts, God!
How vast is their sum!

PSA.139.18.t: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
s: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand.
When I wake up, I am still with you.

PSA.142.1.t: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
s: I cry with my voice to Yahweh.
With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
PSA.142.1.h: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer.

PSA.142.2.t: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
s: I pour out my complaint before him.
I tell him my troubles.

PSA.142.3.t: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
s: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me,
you knew my route.
On the path in which I walk,
they have hidden a snare for me.

PSA.142.4.t: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
s: Look on my right, and see;
for there is no one who is concerned for me.
Refuge has fled from me.
No one cares for my soul.

PSA.142.5.t: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
s: I cried to you, Yahweh.
I said, “You are my refuge,
my portion in the land of the living.”

PSA.142.6.t: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
s: Listen to my cry,
for I am in desperate need.
Deliver me from my persecutors,
for they are too strong for me.

PSA.142.7.t: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
s: Bring my soul out of prison,
that I may give thanks to your name.
The righteous will surround me,
for you will be good to me.

PSA.145.13.t: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
s: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom.
Your dominion endures throughout all generations.
Yahweh is faithful in all his words,
and loving in all his deeds.

PSA.145.14.t: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.
s: Yahweh upholds all who fall,
and raises up all those who are bowed down.

PSA.145.15.t: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
s: The eyes of all wait for you.
You give them their food in due season.

PSA.145.16.t: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
s: You open your hand,
and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

PSA.145.17.t: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
s: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways,
and gracious in all his works.

PSA.145.18.t: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
s: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him,
to all who call on him in truth.

PSA.145.19.t: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
s: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him.
He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

PSA.147.1.t: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
s: Praise Yah,
for it is good to sing praises to our God;
for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

PSA.147.2.t: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
s: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem.
He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

PSA.147.3.t: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
s: He heals the broken in heart,
and binds up their wounds.

PSA.147.4.t: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
s: He counts the number of the stars.
He calls them all by their names.

PSA.147.5.t: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
s: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power.
His understanding is infinite.

PSA.147.6.t: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
s: Yahweh upholds the humble.
He brings the wicked down to the ground.

PSA.147.7.t: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
s: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving.
Sing praises on the harp to our God,

PSA.147.8.t: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
s: who covers the sky with clouds,
who prepares rain for the earth,
who makes grass grow on the mountains.

PSA.147.9.t: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
s: He provides food for the livestock,
and for the young ravens when they call.

PSA.147.10.t: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
s: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse.
He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

PSA.147.11.t: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
s: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him,
in those who hope in his loving kindness.

REV.21.1.t: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.
s: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

REV.21.2.t: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
s: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

REV.21.3.t: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
s: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

REV.21.4.t: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
s: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

REV.21.5.t: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
s: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

ROM.5.1.t: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
s: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

ROM.5.2.t: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
s: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

ROM.5.3.t: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
s: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

ROM.5.4.t: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
s: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

ROM.5.5.t: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
s: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

ROM.8.18.t: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
s: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

ROM.8.19.t: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
s: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

ROM.8.20.t: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
s: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

ROM.8.21.t: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
s: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

ROM.8.22.t: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
s: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

ROM.8.23.t: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
s: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

ROM.8.24.t: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
s: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

ROM.8.25.t: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
s: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

ROM.8.26.t: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
s: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

ROM.8.27.t: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
s: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

ROM.8.28.t: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
s: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

ROM.8.31.t: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
s: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

ROM.8.32.t: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
s: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

ROM.8.33.t: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
s: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

ROM.8.34.t: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
s: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

ROM.8.35.t: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
s: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

ROM.8.36.t: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
s: Even as it is written,
“For your sake we are killed all day long.
We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

ROM.8.37.t: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
s: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

ROM.8.38.t: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
s: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

ROM.8.39.t: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
s: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ROM.12.1.t: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
s: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

ROM.12.2.t: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
s: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

ROM.12.3.t: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.
s: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

ROM.12.4.t: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
s: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

ROM.12.5.t: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,
s: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

ROM.12.6.t: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;
s: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

ROM.12.7.t: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;
s: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

ROM.12.8.t: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
s: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

ROM.12.9.t: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
s: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

ROM.12.10.t: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,
s: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

ROM.12.11.t: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
s: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

ROM.12.12.t: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
s: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

ROM.12.13.t: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.
s: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

ROM.12.14.t: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
s: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

ROM.12.15.t: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
s: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

ROM.12.16.t: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
s: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

ROM.12.17.t: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
s: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

ROM.12.18.t: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
s: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

ROM.12.19.t: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
s: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

ROM.12.20.t: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
s: Therefore
“If your enemy is hungry, feed him.
If he is thirsty, give him a drink;
for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

ROM.12.21.t: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
s: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

ROM.13.6.t: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.
s: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

ROM.13.7.t: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
s: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

ROM.13.8.t: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
s: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

ROM.13.9.t: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
s: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

ROM.13.10.t: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
s: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

ROM.15.1.t: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
s: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

ROM.15.2.t: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
s: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

ROM.15.3.t: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
s: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

ROM.15.4.t: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
s: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

ROM.15.5.t: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,
s: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

ROM.15.6.t: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
s: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ROM.15.7.t: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
s: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

RUT.1.6.t: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab; for she had heard in the country of Moab how Yahweh had visited his people in giving them bread.
s: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab; for she had heard in the country of Moab how Yahweh had visited his people in giving them bread.

RUT.1.7.t: She went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her. They went on the way to return to the land of Judah.
s: She went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her. They went on the way to return to the land of Judah.

RUT.1.8.t: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go, return each of you to her mother’s house. May Yahweh deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.
s: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go, return each of you to her mother’s house. May Yahweh deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.

RUT.1.9.t: May Yahweh grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.” Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices, and wept.
s: May Yahweh grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.”
Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices, and wept.

RUT.1.10.t: They said to her, “No, but we will return with you to your people.”
s: They said to her, “No, but we will return with you to your people.”

RUT.1.11.t: Naomi said, “Go back, my daughters. Why do you want to go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
s: Naomi said, “Go back, my daughters. Why do you want to go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

RUT.1.12.t: Go back, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, ‘I have hope,’ if I should even have a husband tonight, and should also bear sons,
s: Go back, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, ‘I have hope,’ if I should even have a husband tonight, and should also bear sons,

RUT.1.13.t: would you then wait until they were grown? Would you then refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, for it grieves me seriously for your sakes, for Yahweh’s hand has gone out against me.”
s: would you then wait until they were grown? Would you then refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, for it grieves me seriously for your sakes, for Yahweh’s hand has gone out against me.”

RUT.1.14.t: They lifted up their voices and wept again; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her.
s: They lifted up their voices and wept again; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her.

RUT.1.15.t: She said, “Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”
s: She said, “Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”

RUT.1.16.t: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
s: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.

RUT.1.17.t: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”
s: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”

RUT.1.18.t: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.
s: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.

RUT.2.1.t: Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.
s: Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.

RUT.2.2.t: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.” She said to her, “Go, my daughter.”
s: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.”
She said to her, “Go, my daughter.”

RUT.2.3.t: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.
s: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.

RUT.2.4.t: Behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, “May Yahweh be with you.” They answered him, “May Yahweh bless you.”
s: Behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, “May Yahweh be with you.”
They answered him, “May Yahweh bless you.”

RUT.2.5.t: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, “Whose young lady is this?”
s: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, “Whose young lady is this?”

RUT.2.6.t: The servant who was set over the reapers answered, “It is the Moabite lady who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab.
s: The servant who was set over the reapers answered, “It is the Moabite lady who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab.

RUT.2.7.t: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.’ So she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, except that she rested a little in the house.”
s: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.’ So she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, except that she rested a little in the house.”

RUT.2.8.t: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Don’t go to glean in another field, and don’t go from here, but stay here close to my maidens.
s: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Don’t go to glean in another field, and don’t go from here, but stay here close to my maidens.

RUT.2.9.t: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”
s: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”

RUT.2.10.t: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favor in your sight, that you should take knowledge of me, since I am a foreigner?”
s: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favor in your sight, that you should take knowledge of me, since I am a foreigner?”

RUT.2.11.t: Boaz answered her, “I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and have come to a people that you didn’t know before.
s: Boaz answered her, “I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and have come to a people that you didn’t know before.

RUT.2.12.t: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”
s: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”

RUT.2.13.t: Then she said, “Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, because you have comforted me, and because you have spoken kindly to your servant, though I am not as one of your servants.”
